He lowers his chest towards the floor in a push-up motion while maintaining his balance. He is seen on a stationary bicycle with blue foam handlebars, a weight bench lifting a small plastic barbell with yellow and red plates, and a walker with blue and yellow steps. The background features colorful wall murals and wood-textured flooring. (3) The boy transitions through several dance clips in different indoor settings. He wears various outfits: a cream hoodie, a light blue t-shirt with space graphics, a color-blocked sweatshirt with a rice ball graphic, and a grey t-shirt. In another, he is on a paved path with green bushes and grass, swinging a white badminton racket with a white handle at a shuttlecock. (5) The boy appears in a children's clothing store, walking down an aisle between racks of colorful clothes. He wears a yellow t-shirt under a light blue denim jacket with white flower embroidery and khaki shorts. He walks with a confident stride, mimicking a fashion runway model, and eventually reaches out towards the camera lens. (6) The boy stands in an indoor room with light-colored wooden flooring. He wears a yellow t-shirt and patterned white underwear. He looks directly into the lens and speaks excitedly, gesturing with his hands and body. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his expressive facial features as he speaks with high energy.
